recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure wearing a paisley shirt is surrounded by four additional heads branching out in a radial, star-like formation. The illustration uses fine ink outlines with soft, multi-colored pencil shading in a rainbow gradient. The background is a flat, off-white cream color.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry of heads around a central torso
Contrast between detailed paisley patterns and white negative space in hair
Harmonious rainbow color transitions across skin tones
Integration of heavy bubble typography with the illustrative style
coreInvariants: Paisley pattern on the central garment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a five-headed radial figure centered in the frame, occupying approximately 70% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central head facing forward serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-center head and moves clockwise around the radial arrangement of faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the corners and background emphasizes the central organic shape.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream background providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black ink outlines defining the forms.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pastel rainbow gradients (pink, yellow, green, blue) used for shading and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value colors create a soft, ethereal psychedelic effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid solid black fills except for thin lines

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are squashed and tightly packed to form a cohesive block

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space above the illustration

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative style for all primary text to maintain psychedelic impact.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal lines with arrows for technical metadata
Circular logo framing in bottom corner

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an illustration on a cream background of a central male figure in a paisley shirt with four additional heads branching out radially. Use fine black ink outlines and soft rainbow-colored pencil shading for skin tones. Leave the hair as white negative space with minimal line detail.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two rows of heavy, rounded bubble lettering in the top left corner. Apply a horizontal rainbow gradient fill and a thin black outline to the letters. Ensure letters are tightly packed.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent cream color?
Do the skin tones feature a soft rainbow gradient?
Is the typography ultra-bold and rounded?

adjustableVariables: Number of heads in the radial pattern
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likenesses
postGenerationChecks: Check for fine ink-like line quality
Ensure the rainbow gradient is horizontal across the text
Verify the paisley pattern is intricate but not overwhelming
Confirm the hair remains largely white negative space
Check that the radial heads feel connected to the central body
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a radial illustrative subject with soft rainbow pencil shading and heavy bubble-style typography on a neutral cream field.
